Median with an inter-quantile band across individuals

Source: R/plot.R
panel_band.Rd

Shows the spread of individuals, not just the average.

Usage

panel_band(
  x,
  var,
  by = NULL,
  period = NULL,
  fun_time = "mean",
  lower = "p25",
  upper = "p75",
  centre = "median",
  min_n = NULL,
  max_groups = 6,
  tag = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  return = c("plot", "table"),
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A tidy_panel.

var

The variable to plot.

by

Grouping column(s) to aggregate individuals into (e.g. a region); NULL for one overall series. Use ".id" to keep individuals.

period

Coarsen time to "hour", "day", "week", "month", "quarter" or "year", or "all" to collapse time completely (one value per group); NULL keeps the native frequency. Irregular timestamps (kind = "time") must be given a period.

fun_time

Summary applied within each individual when several periods collapse into one (default "mean"; use "sum" for flows).

lower, upper

Band edges as percentile names ("p25", "p75", "p10", "p90").

centre

Centre line summary (default "median").

min_n

Drop group-periods with fewer than this many individuals (a privacy / noise threshold).

max_groups

Keep only this many groups (largest by individuals).

tag

Optional figure number or label, drawn in a square at the top right.

source

Source line for the footer; default is the source given to as_panel().

style

Look for this chart: one of panel_styles().

return

"plot" or "table".

title, subtitle

Optional text; defaults are generated.
